profile.headline: Senior Salesforce Developer at Aura
profile.summary:
Graduated with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science.
Main programming language is Java (3 years), AngularJS and Force.com's Apex.

Highly motivated programmer with more than 3 years of experience in software development. Currently exploring the CRM world with AngularJS and Salesforce.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Salesforce Developer
positions.description:
Formerly Intersections, Inc., acquired in 2019.

• Primary responsibilities: Developing and supporting the CRM (Customer Relationship Management) solutions on Salesforce platform for Identity Guard plus working on Core System
• Full-Stack Salesforce Developer: Designing and implementing Salesforce’s CRM solutions with Model-View-Controller using HTML, AngularJS, Bootstrap, Javascript, JQuery, Apex language, SQL query, JSON, … Working with both front-end and back-end
• Java Developer: Developing Core System back-end using Java with Spring, Spring Data, Gradle. Experienced with IntelliJ IDEA, Postman, MySQL, Docker
• Working in an Agile environment using JIRA’s Agile and Kanban Board, Bitbucket, Git
• Working with various API and JSON from systems such as Core, inContact using HTTP Request and Response

positions.title: Partime Contractor
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities include:
•	Built website and manage e-commerce website
•	Day to day website maintenance and improvements including: designing, coding, testing of various internal software and script, maintaining databases.
Projects Included:
•	Successfully helped moving the business online with a credit card payment system, and automating the works with custom-made software.
•	Designing and working with Squarespace web development tool and credit card payment system.
•	Implementing Java software that uses Apache POI and Open CSV library to convert exported CSV files from Squarespace into Microsoft Excel files and modify them
•	Developing a Java software using Eclipse tool. The software has an UI that user can use to enter soccer teams data into Microsoft Access SQL database and manipulate the data to generate schedule for matches with different constraints
•	Implementing Java software that uses Apache POI to access Microsoft Excel files to get and edit data for making soccer schedule
•	Creating and taking care of website on Google Sites, Squarespace.com
•	Making registration forms using Google Document and writing scripts using Google script (Java script) that interact with the registration data
